CVE-2026-99161.title: i2c: viai2c-wmt: Fix clock leak in wmt_i2c_probe()
CVE-2026-99161.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

i2c: viai2c-wmt: Fix clock leak in wmt_i2c_probe()

In wmt_i2c_probe(), i2c->clk is acquired using of_clk_get(). If any
subsequent operation fails or when the module is unloaded, the clock
reference count is never decremented via clk_put(), leading to a
resource leak.

Switch to devm_clk_get() so that the clock is automatically managed
and released.

CVE-2026-99529.title: wifi: b43: fix use-after-free in b43_bcma_remove()
CVE-2026-99529.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

wifi: b43: fix use-after-free in b43_bcma_remove()

b43_one_core_detach() frees the struct b43_wldev it is given the bus
device of. b43_bcma_remove() then reads wldev->dev again to free the bus
device, which is a read of freed memory.

b43_ssb_remove() does not have the problem: it takes a copy of wldev->dev
at the start. Do the same here.
